title: The Domain of the Body
coreMove: Train your body to help your values: sleep, movement, food, and limits turn stillness from a clear thought into steady conduct when pressure arrives.

exampleSpecs.audience: care workers who rely on adrenaline before pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: a clear handoff under pressure or a jittery performance covered by caffeine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hyun replaces coffee and pep talk with physical rehearsal, using Sadaharu Oh as the model

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders whose preparation ignores the body carrying it
exampleSpecs.stakes: the body may enter pressure brittle while the plan looks polished
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before the call, the protagonist assigns attention to stance, water, and one question instead of treating the body as an afterthought.

exampleSpecs.audience: instructors under social pressure to prove toughness
exampleSpecs.stakes: protect a hurt body or preserve a public display
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lana faces two bad options and lets the injured body set the limit

exampleSpecs.audience: coaches who confuse volume with discipline
exampleSpecs.stakes: protect attention and the wrist or let extra reps hide poor form
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Peyton and Milo discover that Oh's practice means clean restraint, not endless swings

exampleSpecs.audience: athletes who treat exhaustion as proof of seriousness
exampleSpecs.stakes: train timing that sees clearly or practice past the point of learning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The expected winner loses because fatigue blunts perception

exampleSpecs.audience: students copying famous routines without copying the support system
exampleSpecs.stakes: learn from practice or turn a model into panic reps
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hugo and Theophile turn Oh's example into rest, food, and ten clean swings
